profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Kroger Technology
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with over 6 years of experience in web development, with a strong commitment to best practices and a drive for staying up to date in an ever-changing industry.

Skilled in frontend/backend web development (JavaScript/TypeScript, React/Redux, PHP, Node.js)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for building and maintaining internal tool systems.
 •  Collaborated with UX and Product to set quarterly plans
 •  Built diverse greenfield apps for on boarding and managing units around the world.
 •  Increased employee field reporting adherence by redesigning existing tools.
 •  Collaborated with cross-functional teams to develop a user-centric ecosystem.
 •  Wrote application-level code to interact with backend databases.
 •  Refactored knowledge base and documentation on a daily basis.
 •  Technologies used: JavaScript, React/Redux, Sass, PHP, Laravel, JSON:API.

projects.title: Bob Ross D3 Data Visualization
projects.description: In this project, we used D3 data visualization to illustrate the number of features Bob Ross painted in his landscapes in any given season of his television program. Data are visualized in a scatterplot, bar graph and line graph. Most of my work in the project focused on the bar graph section.

projects.title: Reactants - 🌐  eLearning blog created using Gatsby.js and Netlify
projects.description:
On this project I made use of gatsby blog starter which comes with all the configuration routes and styles out of the box, that said, in order to use gatsby is really important to understand its ecosystem and the use of GraphQL. I also use Netlify hosting solution to hook the gitHub repository to the building pipeline process, anytime I push a commit to the repository a new build is trigger.

I am hoping with this new blog start writing tutorials about how to become a proficient frontend developer starting from JavaScript fundamentals and moving to more advanced React/TypeScript topcis.
